description: Curated student threat scenarios and legitimate academic communications for ScamShield.

samples.text: Dear Student, Congratulations! You have been shortlisted for Remote Data Analyst Internship at TechCorp. Stipend: INR 45,000/month. No interview required. To confirm your laptop dispatch and slot, deposit a refundable security fee of Rs. 1,999 to UPI ID techcorp.dispatch@okhdfcbank within 2 hours.
samples.label: scam
